name: KromiumEngine
description: The core interface representing the running Kromium engine. Manages lifecycle states, native binary initialization and disposal, browser client sessions, global cookie management, scheme handler registration, and engine-wide download operations.
whenToUse: Obtain via Kromium.createEngine(config, provider) or provider.createEngine(config) to control the engine lifecycle, observe states via StateFlow, and spawn isolated KromiumClient sessions.

properties.name: state
properties.description: The current state of the engine (e.g. downloading, extracting, ready).

properties.name: info
properties.description: Gets information about the current engine installation.

properties.name: cookieManager
properties.description: Global cookie manager for this engine.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the engine asynchronously, downloading/extracting binaries if necessary.

methods.name: initializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the engine returning a Java CompletableFuture.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the engine, cleaning up native resources.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new isolated browser client session.

methods.name: registerSchemeHandler
methods.signature: fun registerSchemeHandler(schemeName: String, domainName: String? = null, handler: KromiumAssetHandler): Boolean
methods.description: Registers a custom protocol scheme handler factory with the engine.

methods.name: cancelDownload
methods.description: Programmatically cancels an in-progress download identified by its download ID across any active browser session.

methods.name: pauseDownload
methods.description: Programmatically pauses an in-progress download identified by its download ID across any active browser session.

methods.name: resumeDownload
methods.description: Programmatically resumes a paused download identified by its download ID across any active browser session.

methods.name: isDownloadPaused
methods.description: Checks whether an in-progress download is currently paused across any active browser session.

methods.name: clearSchemeHandlers
methods.description: Clears all registered custom scheme handler factories.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.jcef.JcefProvider

suspend fun initEngine() {
    val engine = JcefProvider.createEngine(KromiumConfig.builder().build())
    engine.initialize()
    val client = engine.createClient()
}
